findings.text: Bluefin Bakery Co. is a family-owned bakery chain with 12 stores across Oregon, founded in 1998.
Voted 'Best Bakery' by Portland Eats readers in 2025, Bluefin is known for its organic sourdough and loyal neighborhood following.
Firmographics (fictional): founded 1998, 12 stores, family-owned, based in Portland, Oregon.
Online orders are taken by phone and written into paper notebooks; the owners say they lose track of custom cake orders during the holiday rush.
They are looking for a simple online ordering system before the next expansion, according to a recent interview.

findings.text: Nordwind Logistics GmbH is a Hamburg-based freight forwarding company founded in 2011. The company operates a fleet of 40 trucks and employs 85 people across two warehouses near the Port of Hamburg.
Nordwind won the 2024 NordLogistik Award for sustainable transport and is known as a trusted regional carrier with long-standing customer relationships.
Firmographics (fictional): founded 2011, 85 employees, headquarters Hamburg, fleet of 40 trucks, two warehouses.
Customer inquiries are currently handled manually via shared email inboxes and spreadsheets, which the team describes as a growing bottleneck during peak season.
The company is hiring three additional dispatchers to cope with the load, according to its careers page.
